headline: NVIDIA falls 48% from its peak over doubts about AI
summary: NVIDIA has fallen 48% from its peak, reportedly losing about $2.5 trillion in market value, extending a steep run of losses.
why: NVIDIA designs the graphics processors widely used for AI training and data centres, so its share price is a key barometer of AI sentiment.

impacts.name: NVIDIA
impacts.why: The shares have fallen 48% from their peak, as reported.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Doubts about the durability of AI demand have weighed on the chipmaker's shares, according to the report.
original_headline: NVIDIA pierde 48% desde su máximo por dudas sobre la IA
